scientific_integrity: Analytic Bartlett-QR proof of all real-moment thresholds, exact tail constant and Gaussian weak limit; symbolic and numerical regression checks support implementation agreement but are not an infinite proof. Previous publication priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic three-dimensional path matrix with a fixed Gaussian sketch and one Hessenberg coefficient; no conclusion for general matrices, finite-precision solvers, conditional embeddings or other sketch distributions.
title: A sharp inverse-chi moment frontier for Gaussian-sketched Arnoldi Hessenberg noise
